review_description: Great quotation process as I had plenty of personal wants for the install.At the end of the day best value for money on a top the line Rec alpha black series panel + Fronius inverter.

LC are really at the top of their game, They designed a excellent system, really helped heaps with our paper work, did a quality installation. and   They passed on the cost saving of a high Aussie dollar and the recent big reductions in Mono cystristal panals. All other solar companies were still using their april price lists and pocketing the savings themselves.-lyle
